name: plan-learning-path
title_zh: 先探底再铺路，按依赖排序的学习路径生成器
tagline_zh: 不按课时排课，按知识依赖铺路。先测出你已会什么，再倒推每一步该学什么，跳过重复内容，直达目标。
tagline_en: No more linear syllabi. It maps what you already know, then chains only the missing concepts in dependency order.
desc_en: Build a short dependency-based path from a learner's current knowledge to a learning goal. Use after a knowledge probe or when the learner provides a clear starting level and outcome.
why_zh: 它不按目录顺序硬排，而是先探明你的已知边界，再以目标为终点反向构建依赖链，只补缺口，不炒冷饭。
why_en: It reverse-engineers from the goal, not the textbook. Builds a prerequisite graph and prunes nodes you've mastered, so every.
limit_zh: 需要先有知识探测结果或用户明确自报起点；只生成路径规划，不含具体课件与练习。
limit_en: Requires a prior knowledge probe or a self-reported starting level. Outputs a plan only, no lessons or exercises. Vague goals without anchors will.
title_en: Dependency-ordered learning path builder that probes your.
